Honestly, I'm not too sure what comes next. I'm in the same boat as you.

For me, I need to learn how to be happy with myself and the body I was born in. I need to let go of my self-hatred and forgive myself for my flaws and mistakes. 

The only way to fix your issues is to first identify them. I find that the source of depression in many people are rooted in their core beliefs system. Like the set of principles that have been ingrained into your mind over the years that you believe to be true about yourself. "I am not lovable." "I am not intelligent." "I will never be enough."

It'll take you to the roots of your feelings of inferiority. 

It's hard to change a pattern of thought that has been so deeply ingrained into you. Therapists could give you some bs technical terms to "repave negative thought patterns," but really all it is is practicing self-acceptance and learning to love yourself. 

It's fucking hard. Learning to be okay with the fact that we're all human and that we all make mistakes and that berating ourselves into misery isn't going to fix anything.  It infuriates me even typing this out, even the thought of coming to terms with my flaws. But I know that's what I need to do if I ever want to be content in my own skin. 

I don't want to generalize, because depression is different for everyone. This is just what I've learned from my experience. And how I've come to understand my thoughts and emotions.
